resources.string: Short names and terms sent to the speech provider. This existing list also helps post-processing. The recognition limit still applies.

Additional names and terms sent only to your text-processing provider when a processing mode is used. They do not use the speech recognizer’s prompt budget. Larger lists increase request size and must fit your model’s context window.
One name or term per line

Your rules correct complete words or phrases in recognized dictation, ignoring letter case. Applied locally once, before optional post-processing. These rules are not sent as a list to the speech provider.
